epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify successful startup.

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to configure docker-compose and add a health-check, so that the full stack can be started with a single command and its status verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local development environment, When the user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully and an integration test verifies the startup.
Given the stack is running, When the health-check endpoint is accessed, Then it returns a healthy status and automated checks verify this response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce steps to start local environment from >5 manual commands to 1 automated command

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: The frontend UI must allow users to edit existing epidemiological materials.
R2: The frontend UI must allow users to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Add edit and delete capabilities to material UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend update for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions, so that the cataloging management can be fully realized without outdated entries.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system, When a user chooses to edit it from the UI, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint, updates the view, and unit/E2E tests verify this flow.
Given an existing material, When a user chooses to delete it, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint, removes it from the view, and unit/E2E tests verify this flow.
slices.tocConstraintRef: missing frontend edit and delete UI controls
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce user clicks for update/delete operations from undefined to <3 clicks

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Unauthenticated users attempting to access or modify the catalog must be blocked.
R2: Unauthenticated users must be prompted to log in.

slices.title: Implement authentication blocking and login prompt
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication checks, so that unauthenticated users are correctly blocked and redirected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then they are blocked and unit/integration tests verify the rejection.
Given a blocked unauthenticated user, When the blocking occurs, Then they are prompted to log in and E2E tests verify the prompt.
slices.tocConstraintRef: missing route guards and session checks
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated API access success rate from 100% to 0%
